home_idea_captain_text: You. Agents ask before anything risky, and every step is written down so you can check it.
home_idea_crew_text: The agents you already use, Claude Code, Codex, omp or OpenCode, each with a name, a role and its own place to work.
home_idea_lead: AI agents already write code, answer customers and sort tasks, and they are fast. Fast is not the same as arriving. Atlas gives them what sailors always needed, and keeps a person at the helm.
home_idea_map_text: How each project works, written once in a file that people and agents both read: what to start, in what order, where the logs are.
home_idea_ships_text: Your computers and servers: Atlas Desktop on your computer, a crew server on a Linux machine you own, and your phone.
home_idea_title: Crossing an ocean takes a map, a ship and a crew.
